notes: Single source of truth for the scrape roster. Both the TypeScript read path
and the Python worker load and validate this file, so the two languages
cannot disagree about what is scraped or where it lives.
`transport` records what the capability probe ACTUALLY found through the real
Camoufox transport (T0.3, 2026-09-11), not what was hoped for. Three
protocols are deliberately not scraped and say why: a silent omission would
look like a gap in the data rather than a decision.
dydx was corrected during the probe: 'forums.dydx.community' is a Common
platform with no public JSON API, while 'dydx.forum' is Discourse and
returns a full topic_list (38 KB verified).

protocols.name: Curve
protocols.note: HTTP 403 from Cloudflare on both gov.curve.fi and gov.curve.finance, through the real Camoufox transport with retries. Not defeatable with the current browser configuration. Excluded from v0.1 rather than retried indefinitely; revisit with a warmer session or a different egress.

protocols.name: Sushi
protocols.note: forum.sushi.com now serves a 275-byte 'COMMON is Live' splash rather than a Discourse instance; governance moved to the Common platform, which exposes no public JSON API. Excluded from v0.1.

protocols.name: Pendle
protocols.note: No public governance forum resolves: forum.pendle.finance, gov.pendle.finance and forum.pendle.xyz all fail DNS. Pendle runs a PIP process, so a forum exists in some form but its host was not discoverable. Excluded from v0.1 pending a confirmed URL.

protocols.name: Hyperliquid
protocols.note: No Discourse forum exists. HIP governance runs through proposal windows and on-chain votes, which needs a bespoke adapter and is out of v0.1 scope.
